mentions.name: Self-hosted Forgejo with Actions runner
mentions.description: Self-hosted code hosting and CI setup using Forgejo with an Actions runner to replace GitHub and GitLab, backed by a backup plan covering documents, the Immich library, the SaaS database, and the Forgejo repositories.
mentions.problem: Replaces GitHub and GitLab with a self-hosted code hosting and CI setup.
mentions.source_excerpt: I completely ditched Github and Gitlab for self hosted forgejo + actions runner. I set up proper backup plan for everything I care (documents, immich library, my SaaS DB, and the forgejo repositories).

evidence.value: I completely ditched Github and Gitlab for self hosted forgejo + actions runner. I set up proper backup plan for everything I care (documents, immich library, my SaaS DB, and the forgejo repositories).
